name: y9c-trading-ot
status: PINNED v1.0 design; OOS scoring NOT authorized (stop-gate: prereg addendum v1.1 pending, which may extend history to 2008 and must fix the primary run before any OOS result is seen). run.py refuses an OOS run while oos_authorized is false or open_questions is non-empty.

target.label: Trading revenue, Schedule HI item 5.c
target.decumulation: y9c.panel.decumulate unchanged: Q1 as reported; Q2-Q4 = YTD - YTD of the immediately prior calendar quarter of the same year; NaN otherwise

views.T1: industry total, sum of A220_q over all filers with non-null A220 at t, $bn
views.T2: ex-ante bank set: |A220_q| >= 10000 ($k) in all 16 quarters 2018Q1-2021Q4, data <= 2021Q4 only; evaluated through last filing
views.T3: cross-section C_s: TA(i,s-1) >= 100000 ($k, BHCK3545) and non-null A220_q(i,s); r = 1e4 * A220_q / TA_(t-1) in bp

data.raw: 34 NIC BHCF ZIPs 2018Q1-2026Q2 (y9c-panel cache; sha256 per ZIP recorded in vintage.json)
data.availability_rule: D_t = Y-9C due date (40 days after Mar/Jun/Sep quarter end, 45 after Dec 31, next business day under the US federal holiday calendar) + 7 calendar days; a quarter is usable iff D_t <= as_of

baselines.error_quantiles: centre + type-7 quantiles of the bank's own historical errors for that baseline and horizon; < 8 own errors -> pooled scaled errors (errors / pooling scale, multiplied back); flat beyond extreme order statistics

B0.name: SAA-8
B0.rule: type-7 quantiles of the last 8 observed values

B4.name: AR(1)+Q1 on ratio, direct h-step, per bank

B5.name: pooled panel quantile regression on ratio
B5.taus: U19 rearranged (sorted) and interpolated to U99
covariates: sd of daily change in DGS10
sd of daily log SP500 return
B5.optional_BAMLC0A0CM: EXCLUDED: FRED history starts 2023-10-06 (checked 2026-10-06), so it does not cover 2018+

baselines.reference: B* = lowest pooled scaled CRPS on burn-in pseudo-OOS targets 2020Q2-2021Q4, chosen once at 2021Q4; B*_CS likewise on the cross-section population

H1.name: BARY-EW
H1.trim: drop members with pooled burn-in scaled CRPS > 1.25 x best; keep >= 2
H1.s_rule: argmin pooled burn-in pseudo-OOS scaled CRPS, ties -> smallest s

H2.name: WAR-RM
H2.population: banks in C_(t+1) with >= 8 prior quarters of r
H2.rank_map: q_tau = Qhat(Phi(rho z + sqrt(1-rho^2) Phi^-1(tau))); Qhat linear on U99, flat beyond
H2.rho: pooled Pearson of probit ranks over transitions with s+h <= t, clipped [0, 0.99]
H2.scale: 1.4826 x MAD of the last 8 r values <= origin, floored at the 10th percentile across population banks at that origin

scoring.aggregation: equal weight per bank within target quarter, then across quarters; G = sum_t dbar_t / sum_t Sbar_ref_t
scoring.matched_cases: intersection of (bank, target) where both compared methods and the actual exist

test.dm: one-sided on dbar_t; Newey-West Bartlett lag h-1; HLN factor; t_(T-1)
robustness_reported: fixed-smoothing DM (weighted periodogram, m = floor(T^(1/3)), t_(2m))
test.fail: one-sided 95% upper bound on G < 0.03, or G <= 0
test.incomplete: otherwise, or < 16 valid targets, data-integrity failure, prereg pin failure

secondary_and_sensitivity: as prereg §4.1-§4.4, §5.6 (S1-S10), §5.7 (F1-F5); none can change a primary verdict; every OOS execution appended to trials.jsonl

open_questions.text: B6 (eb_forecast_origin, unchanged default T=12) needs a complete 13-quarter window of the ratio, which begins 2018Q2 (first lagged denominator). It is therefore undefined at pseudo-origins 2020Q1-2021Q1: on the burn-in pseudo-OOS window (targets 2020Q2-2021Q4) B6 exists only for targets 2021Q3-2021Q4 (38 of 133 bank cases; same pattern on the cross-section). The prereg's trim rule, s selection and B* selection assume 133 cases for every member. Options: (a) matched cases only (all members on 2021Q3-Q4, 38 cases); (b) each member on its own available cases; (c) exclude B6 from M0 and from B* eligibility; (d) other. Must be fixed before the freeze; v1.1 history extension to 2008 would remove the problem if the burn-in moves.

Prereg says B6 forecast = Tweedie posterior-mean ratio x TA_t (TA = trading assets, BHCK3545), but asset_ratio uses BHCK2170 total assets. Proposed: pass BHCK3545 into eb's total_assets slot (eb.py code unchanged). Confirm or choose total assets.
B6 'empirical residual quantiles': proposed = in-sample one-step residuals over the 12-quarter EB window, reconstructed from the returned fit (12 per bank, so own errors).

Pooled scaled errors at pseudo-origins before 2021Q4 would use s_i (2018Q1-2021Q4 MAD), i.e. data after the pseudo-origin. Proposed pooling scale = 1.4826 MAD over 2018Q1..min(origin, 2021Q4); scoring still uses frozen s_i.
B*_CS: baselines on the cross-section are run in ratio space (centres and errors in r bp, pooled errors scaled by s_i^r; B5 pooled over C_(s+h) members; B6 level forecast / TA_t).

T1 (H1d, secondary) has one series: with < 8 own errors there is nothing to pool, and B4's fallback B2 does not exist on levels. Proposed: own errors whatever their count (>= 2); B4 fallback = level random walk.

Minor conventions: SES initialised at the first observed r and held when r is missing; U19 -> U99 interpolation holds the 0.05/0.95 values flat in the tails; at h = 4 B5 drops r_(t+h-4) (identical to r_t); trailing-8 MAD uses the last 8 observed r values.
